home.lead: zugher.com is a multi-tenant SaaS foundation that enables any territory — country, region, community, sector or ecosystem — to structure and activate its economic development with the help of artificial intelligence.
home.apps.aside: Each territory activates the modules it needs. The foundation is shared, personalization is done through a simple configuration file.
app.01.name: Territory promotion
app.01.desc: Showcase of the territory and its sub-territories: countries, regions, sectors, communities.
app.02.name: Opportunity bank
app.02.desc: Catalog of project opportunities qualified by territory and sector.
app.03.name: Skill assessment
app.03.desc: Entrepreneur assessment, identification of strengths and support needs.
app.04.name: Networking
app.04.desc: Qualified matching between entrepreneurs, investors, service providers and institutions.
app.05.name: Business plan
app.05.desc: AI-assisted generation, ready to share with partners and investors.
app.06.name: Crowdfunding & Financing
app.06.desc: Crowdfunding and connection with financial institutions.
app.07.name: Recruitment
app.07.desc: Job posting, candidate pool, AI-powered matching.
app.08.name: Business development
app.08.desc: Commercial tools for general public, B2B and public procurement.
app.09.name: Tenders
app.09.desc: Management of public and private tenders: publication, application, follow-up.
home.seg.aside: The general public accesses self-service with displayed pricing. The professional segment goes through direct sales and receives a personalized instance.
home.btoc.title: General public
home.btob.title: Professional
home.ai.title: Artificial intelligence, natively integrated into the journey.
home.ai.lead: AI is not a side module: it runs through the entire platform, from matching to business plan generation, from opportunity scoring to writing assistance.
contact.lead: Our team responds to all inquiries within 48 business hours. Whether you are an entrepreneur, investor, public agency or simply curious about the territory, write to us.
contact.field.message_ph: Describe your request, your project or the reason for contacting us…
contact.consent: I agree that the information provided will be used to process my request, in accordance with the privacy policy. No data is shared with third parties.
contact.aside.title: A team at your service.
contact.aside.desc: All messages received through this form are processed by the marketplace administration. An automatic acknowledgment is sent to the email address provided.
contact.feedback.title: Message sent successfully

nl.h1: Receive the latest news from the Valoria territory.
nl.lead: A monthly letter to follow opportunities, new projects, financing programs and ecosystem events — selected according to your profile.
nl.field.phone_hint: Used only in case of email delivery issues
nl.field.profile_hint: Select the profile that best matches your activity. This allows us to personalize the content sent.
nl.consent: I agree to receive the monthly zugher.com newsletter. I can unsubscribe at any time via the link in each email, in accordance with the privacy policy.
nl.aside.title: A curated letter, never commercial.
nl.aside.desc: Depending on the profile you choose, you receive the opportunities, financing or offers that match your activity in the Valoria territory.
